name: figure_1_runtime_and_checkpoint_controls
scope: Marker-free selection observations, not held-out confidence intervals. Request TTFT includes Queue waiting. Service TTFT is NOT_MEASURED. The original-runtime row is an independent start.

name: figure_2_spatial_quantum_tradeoff
scope: Measured static full-prompt Loop31 and 64-token suffix selections. Normal and Green contexts have different execution resources. Each method has its own matched Zero. No hardware concurrency claim applies.

name: figure_4_paired_queue_and_decode_tail
scope: Measured signed Host intervals on one paired Arrival trace. Means share identical requests. Not a GPU critical-path or DMA decomposition. The Decode strata are descriptive, not causal.

name: figure_5_selection_ttft_decode_tradeoff
scope: Observed selection runs. Dashed lines are relative to full-device Zero. Marker area increases with actual offloaded request count. Different execution policies require their own matched controls. This plot cannot establish GO.

name: figure_3_held_out_confirmation
scope: Paired independent starts by Arrival seed. The repeated Zero is a sensitivity control. Three seeds provide limited confidence coverage. Ratios below one improve latency.

name: diagnostic_selection_observed_timeline
scope: Paired actual N128 requests. Host submission, completion observations, transfer intervals, and output deliveries only. No GPU kernel bars or physical idle windows are inferred.
